title: General two-function hypercontractivity
statement:
Fix real exponents $1 \le p \le u$ with $u \ge 2$, and a noise rate $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$ satisfying $\rho \le \sqrt{(p-1)/(u-1)}$. Then for every pair of Boolean functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$,
\[
  \langle f, T_\rho g\rangle
  \;\le\;
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{f}^{u/(u-1)}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{(u-1)/u}\,
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{g}^{p}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{1/p},
\]
where $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ is the $L^2$ inner product, $\E$ the expectation, and $T_\rho$ the noise operator, all taken with respect to the uniform measure on the hypercube.
hypotheses_covered: f, g arbitrary Boolean functions of arity n
